frozen_candidate_root_contribution: mwt denotes the LIFELESS condition - the state of being without hayah - standing in systematic paradigmatic opposition to the root h-y-y (life/living). It is anchored not by any external gloss but by invariant Quran-internal antonymy: yuhyi wa-yumit, al-hayy/al-mayyit, al-ahya'/al-amwat (35:22), mahyahum wa-mamatuhum (45:21), la yamutu fiha wa-la yahya (20:74). Morphology, not the root, supplies argument structure: Form I (yamutu/mata) = an entity's intransitive passage INTO the lifeless state (undergoer-subject, never causative); Form IV (yumit/amata) = an agent (canonically God) putting into it; the nominals name the state/onset-event (mawt), its countable instance (mawtah/mamat), or the entity in it (mayyit, mawta, amwat). The dietary maytah (carrion) is a lexicalized nominal specialization.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root mwt is about being without life, defined against its opposite root 'to live'. Whether it is a human, a barren land, a seed, or an idol, the thing called 'dead' is simply on the non-living side of the life/death pair. The verb shapes carry the rest of the meaning: the plain (Form I) verb means an entity itself passes into that lifeless state and never takes an object, while the causative (Form IV) verb means someone - in the Quran, God - makes something die. Nouns name the death-event, the lifeless state, or the dead ones. The one specialized use is 'maytah', a legal food-law term for carrion (an animal that died on its own), which adds a prohibition/impurity meaning the plain root does not have.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: mwt does NOT entail: (1) cessation of a PRIOR life - idols are amwat ghayr ahya' (16:21:1:1) and humans were amwatan before being given life (2:28:5:1); the nucleus is lifelessness, not dying-from-life. (2) irreversibility/finality - the dead are revived (yuhyi al-mawta), the earth revived after mawt (30:50), two deaths / a first death (40:11:3:1, 44:56:6:2). (3) violent killing (qatl) - sharply co-listed as the distinct, non-slaying member: qutilu aw matu (22:58:9:1), mata aw qutila (3:144:11:1), min al-mawt aw al-qatl (33:16:8:2). (4) soul-taking (tawaffa) - distinguished as event vs act-on-soul (39:42:8:1 allati lam tamut fi manamiha). (5) intrinsic moral valence - believer and kafir alike matu; the moral weight sits in adjuncts (wa-hum kuffar), not in mwt. Boundary within the root: the ONSET (mawt coming) is distinct from the ACHIEVED state (mayyit): 14:17 ya'tihi al-mawt ... wa-ma huwa bi-mayyit.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 2:28:5:1 kuntum amwatan fa-ahyakum ('you were dead, then He gave you life') places the mawt-state PRIOR to life, so nothing living had ceased; reinforced by 16:21:1:1 (idols amwat ghayr ahya', never alive) and 40:11:3:1 (amattana ithnatayn, two deaths). This refutes any 'cessation of prior life' gloss and forces the nucleus to the lifeless CONDITION (negative pole of h-y-y), not a termination event.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: The strongest competitor is that mwt is a derivational family of SEPARATE senses joined only etymologically - animate 'die', inanimate/agrarian 'barrenness of earth', and legal 'carrion' - with no single nucleus. This is refuted Quran-internally for the first two: the text itself BRIDGES person-death and earth-death as one concept, using earth-revival as the explicit model/proof of resurrection - yuhyi al-arda ba3da mawtiha innahu la-muhyi al-mawta (30:50:10:1, 30:50:14:2), kadhalika nukhriju al-mawta right after baladin mayyit (7:57), kadhalika al-nushur (35:9). The h-y-y antonymy is invariant across all these uses. The bridge holds; the multi-sense split fails - EXCEPT for the lexicalized carrion maytah, which is why the account is capped rather than universal. A secondary competitor - the naive 'event of ceasing to live' - is refuted by 2:28:5:1 and 16:21:1:1.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses (A bottom-up, B unity, C adversary) independently converged: one root nucleus (lifelessness as the negative pole of h-y-y), a clean and near-exceptionless Form I (intransitive undergoer) vs Form IV (causative, God-agent) argument-structure mapping, and a single resistant lexicalized nominal sub-class (carrion maytah). The nucleus is broad (165 tokens, all periods, all four form classes), distinctive (hard internal boundaries against qatl and tawaffa), and adversarially undefeated - the adversary could find NO occurrence that breaks a single nucleus. Evidence of that quality would support STRONG, but the contract caps at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE because a coherent resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class (maytah) exists whose legal-impurity content the nucleus does not generate, and because the ADJ/N QAC tags are non-load-bearing (the identical phrase muhyi al-mawta is tagged ADJ at 30:50:14:2/41:39:17:2 but N elsewhere; baldatan/baladin mayyit crosses ADJ and N), so grading on form tags would be an artifact. Result: PREFERRED, MODERATE, REPRESENTATIVE, DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY - honest non-over-grading, not material resistance to the unity claim.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I (base) verb: an animate entity's INTRANSITIVE passage into the lifeless state; the subject is always the undergoer/dier and the verb never takes a direct object (yamutu/mata/matu/mittu/mutu). Cleanly the inceptive of the lifeless-state nucleus.
clusters.classification_rationale: Exceptionless in the packet: every Form I token is intransitive with an undergoer-subject; causation of death is morphologically reserved for Form IV. Refs incl. 16:38:9:1, 20:74:10:1 (la yamutu fiha wa-la yahya), 3:144:11:1 (mata aw qutila), 22:58:9:1 (qutilu aw matu), 3:145:5:1 (an tamuta illa bi-idhni llah), 2:243:15:1 & 3:119:21:1 (imperative mutu).
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Undergoer-subject throughout; sharp internal contrast with qatl (22:58:9:1, 3:144:11:1, 3:156:21:1, 3:157:7:1, 3:158:2:1) and with tawaffa/sleep (39:42:8:1) fixes it as the non-slaying, event-vs-soul-taking member of the field.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form IV verb: an AGENT brings an entity into the lifeless state ('cause to die / put to death'); transitive transitivization of the Form I nucleus. The agent is God in 20 of 21 tokens, canonically in the doublet yuhyi wa-yumit.
clusters.classification_rationale: Near-perfect morphology-to-argument-structure mapping paired with Form I. clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Lexicalized nominal term-of-art 'maytah' = an animal dead-of-itself (carrion) as a forbidden food-substance in the dietary-prohibition frame. Denotationally bridged to the nucleus (a dead animal is lifeless) but carries legal-prohibition and ritual-impurity content the nucleus does not generate.
clusters.classification_rationale: The dietary maytah/carrion tokens (16:115:4:2, 2:173:4:2, 5:3:3:2, 6:139:14:1, 6:145:15:1) are a lexicalized nominal term-of-art for an animal dead-of-itself in a fixed food-prohibition frame (hurrimat 3alaykum al-maytah), carrying legal-prohibition and ritual-impurity (rijs, 6:145) content that the bare lifeless-state nucleus does not generate; the denotation is bridged (a dead animal is lifeless) but the legal connotation is not derivable from the root, so this sub-class resists a single narrow gloss and caps strength at MODERATE.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Always in the food-law list (hurrimat 3alaykum al-maytah wa-l-dam wa-lahm al-khinzir); opposed to illa ma dhakkaytum (5:3) and marked rijs (6:145). Distinct from the compositional 'dead flesh' image lahm akhihi maytan (49:12:24:1), which is NOT lexicalized and stays in the nominal cluster.

occurrence_dispositions.note: The dietary maytah/carrion tokens (16:115:4:2, 2:173:4:2, 5:3:3:2, 6:139:14:1, 6:145:15:1) are a lexicalized nominal term-of-art for an animal dead-of-itself in a fixed food-prohibition frame (hurrimat 3alaykum al-maytah), carrying legal-prohibition and ritual-impurity (rijs, 6:145) content that the bare lifeless-state nucleus does not generate; the denotation is bridged (a dead animal is lifeless) but the legal connotation is not derivable from the root, so this sub-class resists a single narrow gloss and caps strength at MODERATE.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Lexicalized nominal term-of-art 'maytah' = an animal dead-of-itself (carrion) as a forbidden food-substance in the dietary-prohibition frame. Denotationally bridged to the nucleus (a dead animal is lifeless) but carries legal-prohibition and ritual-impurity content the nucleus does not generate.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Always in the food-law list (hurrimat 3alaykum al-maytah wa-l-dam wa-lahm al-khinzir); opposed to illa ma dhakkaytum (5:3) and marked rijs (6:145). Distinct from the compositional 'dead flesh' image lahm akhihi maytan (49:12:24:1), which is NOT lexicalized and stays in the nominal cluster.

occurrence_dispositions.note: Grouped by function, not by tag, because the tags are non-load-bearing (muhyi al-mawta is ADJ at 30:50:14:2/41:39:17:2 but N elsewhere; dead land is ADJ at 7:57:16:1/35:9:10:1 but N at 6:122:3:1). The reversible extraction formula al-hayy/al-mayyit (10:31:15:2, 10:31:17:2, 30:19:4:2, 6:95:9:2, 3:27:12:2) and khalaqa al-mawta wa-l-hayat (67:2:3:2) fix the polar-pole reading. Earth-death is explicitly bridged to dead-raising at 30:50:10:1/30:50:14:2, so it supports rather than fractures the nucleus. 2:28:5:1 kuntum amwatan fa-ahyakum ('you were dead, then He gave you life') places the mawt-state PRIOR to life, so nothing living had ceased; reinforced by 16:21:1:1 (idols amwat ghayr ahya', never alive) and 40:11:3:1 (amattana ithnatayn, two deaths). This refutes any 'cessation of prior life' gloss and forces the nucleus to the lifeless CONDITION (negative pole of h-y-y), not a termination event.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Nominal/attributive forms naming the death-event or lifeless state (mawt, mamat, mawtah), the dead-as-entities (mayyit, mawta, amwat), and lifeless land/matter. All sit on the non-living pole of the h-y-y contrast; the ADJ vs N QAC tag is attributive-vs-substantive syntax, not a meaning boundary.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Includes the pre-life/never-lived evidence (2:28:5:1 kuntum amwatan; 16:21:1:1 idols amwat ghayr ahya'), the ahya'/amwat contrast (35:22:5:2), the martyr correction (2:154:8:1, 3:169:8:1 - do not call them amwat), and the earth-revival cluster (2:164:28:1, 16:65:10:1, 30:19:12:1, 45:5:15:1, 57:17:7:1) all riding the same h-y-y antonymy.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I (base) verb: an animate entity's INTRANSITIVE passage into the lifeless state; the subject is always the undergoer/dier and the verb never takes a direct object (yamutu/mata/matu/mittu/mutu). Cleanly the inceptive of the lifeless-state nucleus.

occurrence_dispositions.note: The dietary maytah/carrion tokens (16:115:4:2, 2:173:4:2, 5:3:3:2, 6:139:14:1, 6:145:15:1) are a lexicalized nominal term-of-art for an animal dead-of-itself in a fixed food-prohibition frame (hurrimat 3alaykum al-maytah), carrying legal-prohibition and ritual-impurity (rijs, 6:145) content that the bare lifeless-state nucleus does not generate; the denotation is bridged (a dead animal is lifeless) but the legal connotation is not derivable from the root, so this sub-class resists a single narrow gloss and caps strength at MODERATE.

occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Always in the food-law list (hurrimat 3alaykum al-maytah wa-l-dam wa-lahm al-khinzir); opposed to illa ma dhakkaytum (5:3) and marked rijs (6:145). Distinct from the compositional 'dead flesh' image lahm akhihi maytan (49:12:24:1), which is NOT lexicalized and stays in the nominal cluster.

occurrence_dispositions.note: Grouped by function, not by tag, because the tags are non-load-bearing (muhyi al-mawta is ADJ at 30:50:14:2/41:39:17:2 but N elsewhere; dead land is ADJ at 7:57:16:1/35:9:10:1 but N at 6:122:3:1). The reversible extraction formula al-hayy/al-mayyit (10:31:15:2, 10:31:17:2, 30:19:4:2, 6:95:9:2, 3:27:12:2) and khalaqa al-mawta wa-l-hayat (67:2:3:2) fix the polar-pole reading. Earth-death is explicitly bridged to dead-raising at 30:50:10:1/30:50:14:2, so it supports rather than fractures the nucleus. 2:28:5:1 kuntum amwatan fa-ahyakum ('you were dead, then He gave you life') places the mawt-state PRIOR to life, so nothing living had ceased; reinforced by 16:21:1:1 (idols amwat ghayr ahya', never alive) and 40:11:3:1 (amattana ithnatayn, two deaths). This refutes any 'cessation of prior life' gloss and forces the nucleus to the lifeless CONDITION (negative pole of h-y-y), not a termination event.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Nominal/attributive forms naming the death-event or lifeless state (mawt, mamat, mawtah), the dead-as-entities (mayyit, mawta, amwat), and lifeless land/matter. All sit on the non-living pole of the h-y-y contrast; the ADJ vs N QAC tag is attributive-vs-substantive syntax, not a meaning boundary.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Includes the pre-life/never-lived evidence (2:28:5:1 kuntum amwatan; 16:21:1:1 idols amwat ghayr ahya'), the ahya'/amwat contrast (35:22:5:2), the martyr correction (2:154:8:1, 3:169:8:1 - do not call them amwat), and the earth-revival cluster (2:164:28:1, 16:65:10:1, 30:19:12:1, 45:5:15:1, 57:17:7:1) all riding the same h-y-y antonymy.

occurrence_dispositions.note: Exceptionless in the packet: every Form I token is intransitive with an undergoer-subject; causation of death is morphologically reserved for Form IV. Refs incl. 16:38:9:1, 20:74:10:1 (la yamutu fiha wa-la yahya), 3:144:11:1 (mata aw qutila), 22:58:9:1 (qutilu aw matu), 3:145:5:1 (an tamuta illa bi-idhni llah), 2:243:15:1 & 3:119:21:1 (imperative mutu).
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I (base) verb: an animate entity's INTRANSITIVE passage into the lifeless state; the subject is always the undergoer/dier and the verb never takes a direct object (yamutu/mata/matu/mittu/mutu). Cleanly the inceptive of the lifeless-state nucleus.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Undergoer-subject throughout; sharp internal contrast with qatl (22:58:9:1, 3:144:11:1, 3:156:21:1, 3:157:7:1, 3:158:2:1) and with tawaffa/sleep (39:42:8:1) fixes it as the non-slaying, event-vs-soul-taking member of the field.

occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The fixed yuhyi wa-yumit doublet directly instantiates the h-y-y/mwt antonymy that anchors the nucleus; the sole non-divine agent (2:258:23:2) is a refuted usurpation and confirms the pattern.

occurrence_dispositions.note: Grouped by function, not by tag, because the tags are non-load-bearing (muhyi al-mawta is ADJ at 30:50:14:2/41:39:17:2 but N elsewhere; dead land is ADJ at 7:57:16:1/35:9:10:1 but N at 6:122:3:1). The reversible extraction formula al-hayy/al-mayyit (10:31:15:2, 10:31:17:2, 30:19:4:2, 6:95:9:2, 3:27:12:2) and khalaqa al-mawta wa-l-hayat (67:2:3:2) fix the polar-pole reading. Earth-death is explicitly bridged to dead-raising at 30:50:10:1/30:50:14:2, so it supports rather than fractures the nucleus. 2:28:5:1 kuntum amwatan fa-ahyakum ('you were dead, then He gave you life') places the mawt-state PRIOR to life, so nothing living had ceased; reinforced by 16:21:1:1 (idols amwat ghayr ahya', never alive) and 40:11:3:1 (amattana ithnatayn, two deaths). occurrence_dispositions.note: Grouped by function, not by tag, because the tags are non-load-bearing (muhyi al-mawta is ADJ at 30:50:14:2/41:39:17:2 but N elsewhere; dead land is ADJ at 7:57:16:1/35:9:10:1 but N at 6:122:3:1). The reversible extraction formula al-hayy/al-mayyit (10:31:15:2, 10:31:17:2, 30:19:4:2, 6:95:9:2, 3:27:12:2) and khalaqa al-mawta wa-l-hayat (67:2:3:2) fix the polar-pole reading. Earth-death is explicitly bridged to dead-raising at 30:50:10:1/30:50:14:2, so it supports rather than fractures the nucleus. 2:28:5:1 kuntum amwatan fa-ahyakum ('you were dead, then He gave you life') places the mawt-state PRIOR to life, so nothing living had ceased; reinforced by 16:21:1:1 (idols amwat ghayr ahya', never alive) and 40:11:3:1 (amattana ithnatayn, two deaths). This refutes any 'cessation of prior life' gloss and forces the nucleus to the lifeless CONDITION (negative pole of h-y-y), not a termination event.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Nominal/attributive forms naming the death-event or lifeless state (mawt, mamat, mawtah), the dead-as-entities (mayyit, mawta, amwat), and lifeless land/matter. All sit on the non-living pole of the h-y-y contrast; the ADJ vs N QAC tag is attributive-vs-substantive syntax, not a meaning boundary.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Includes the pre-life/never-lived evidence (2:28:5:1 kuntum amwatan; 16:21:1:1 idols amwat ghayr ahya'), the ahya'/amwat contrast (35:22:5:2), the martyr correction (2:154:8:1, 3:169:8:1 - do not call them amwat), and the earth-revival cluster (2:164:28:1, 16:65:10:1, 30:19:12:1, 45:5:15:1, 57:17:7:1) all riding the same h-y-y antonymy.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I (base) verb: an animate entity's INTRANSITIVE passage into the lifeless state; the subject is always the undergoer/dier and the verb never takes a direct object (yamutu/mata/matu/mittu/mutu). occurrence_dispositions.note: Grouped by function, not by tag, because the tags are non-load-bearing (muhyi al-mawta is ADJ at 30:50:14:2/41:39:17:2 but N elsewhere; dead land is ADJ at 7:57:16:1/35:9:10:1 but N at 6:122:3:1). The reversible extraction formula al-hayy/al-mayyit (10:31:15:2, 10:31:17:2, 30:19:4:2, 6:95:9:2, 3:27:12:2) and khalaqa al-mawta wa-l-hayat (67:2:3:2) fix the polar-pole reading. Earth-death is explicitly bridged to dead-raising at 30:50:10:1/30:50:14:2, so it supports rather than fractures the nucleus. 2:28:5:1 kuntum amwatan fa-ahyakum ('you were dead, then He gave you life') places the mawt-state PRIOR to life, so nothing living had ceased; reinforced by 16:21:1:1 (idols amwat ghayr ahya', never alive) and 40:11:3:1 (amattana ithnatayn, two deaths). This refutes any 'cessation of prior life' gloss and forces the nucleus to the lifeless CONDITION (negative pole of h-y-y), not a termination event.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I (base) verb: an animate entity's INTRANSITIVE passage into the lifeless state; the subject is always the undergoer/dier and the verb never takes a direct object (yamutu/mata/matu/mittu/mutu). supporting_evidence.verse_text: إِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱذْكُرْ نِعْمَتِى عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَتِكَ إِذْ أَيَّدتُّكَ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ تُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَإِذْ عَلَّمْتُكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَإِذْ تَخْلُقُ مِنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ بِإِذْنِى فَتَنفُخُ فِيهَا فَتَكُونُ طَيْرًۢا بِإِذْنِى وَتُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ بِإِذْنِى وَإِذْ تُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِى وَإِذْ كَفَفْتُ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَنكَ إِذْ جِئْتَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

occurrence_dispositions.note: The dietary maytah/carrion tokens (16:115:4:2, 2:173:4:2, 5:3:3:2, 6:139:14:1, 6:145:15:1) are a lexicalized nominal term-of-art for an animal dead-of-itself in a fixed food-prohibition frame (hurrimat 3alaykum al-maytah), carrying legal-prohibition and ritual-impurity (rijs, 6:145) content that the bare lifeless-state nucleus does not generate; the denotation is bridged (a dead animal is lifeless) but the legal connotation is not derivable from the root, so this sub-class resists a single narrow gloss and caps strength at MODERATE.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Lexicalized nominal term-of-art 'maytah' = an animal dead-of-itself (carrion) as a forbidden food-substance in the dietary-prohibition frame. Denotationally bridged to the nucleus (a dead animal is lifeless) but carries legal-prohibition and ritual-impurity content the nucleus does not generate.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Always in the food-law list (hurrimat 3alaykum al-maytah wa-l-dam wa-lahm al-khinzir); opposed to illa ma dhakkaytum (5:3) and marked rijs (6:145). Distinct from the compositional 'dead flesh' image lahm akhihi maytan (49:12:24:1), which is NOT lexicalized and stays in the nominal cluster.

supporting_evidence.verse_text: حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ وَٱلدَّمُ وَلَحْمُ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ وَٱلْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَٱلْمَوْقُوذَةُ وَٱلْمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَٱلنَّطِيحَةُ وَمَآ أَكَلَ ٱلسَّبُعُ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيْتُمْ وَمَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى ٱلنُّصُبِ وَأَن تَسْتَقْسِمُوا۟ بِٱلْأَزْلَٰمِ ذَٰلِكُمْ فِسْقٌ ٱلْيَوْمَ يَئِسَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن دِينِكُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَٱخْشَوْنِ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِى وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمَ دِينًا فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ فِى مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍ لِّإِثْمٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Includes the pre-life/never-lived evidence (2:28:5:1 kuntum amwatan; 16:21:1:1 idols amwat ghayr ahya'), the ahya'/amwat contrast (35:22:5:2), the martyr correction (2:154:8:1, 3:169:8:1 - do not call them amwat), and the earth-revival cluster (2:164:28:1, 16:65:10:1, 30:19:12:1, 45:5:15:1, 57:17:7:1) all riding the same h-y-y antonymy.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A bottom-up, B unity, C adversary) converged on the same nucleus, the same Form I/IV split, and the same sole resistant sub-class (maytah), with no cross-lens disagreement on grading (all proposed MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE).
candidate_root_contribution: mwt denotes the LIFELESS condition - the state of being without hayah - standing in systematic paradigmatic opposition to the root h-y-y (life/living). It is anchored not by any external gloss but by invariant Quran-internal antonymy: yuhyi wa-yumit, al-hayy/al-mayyit, al-ahya'/al-amwat (35:22), mahyahum wa-mamatuhum (45:21), la yamutu fiha wa-la yahya (20:74). Morphology, not the root, supplies argument structure: Form I (yamutu/mata) = an entity's intransitive passage INTO the lifeless state (undergoer-subject, never causative); Form IV (yumit/amata) = an agent (canonically God) putting into it; the nominals name the state/onset-event (mawt), its countable instance (mawtah/mamat), or the entity in it (mayyit, mawta, amwat). The dietary maytah (carrion) is a lexicalized nominal specialization.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 165 tokens read across all four form classes (ADJ 9, N 96, V 39, V(IV) 21); the invariant h-y-y antonymy (yuhyi wa-yumit, al-hayy/al-mayyit, al-ahya'/al-amwat) is directly observed in verse_text across every class.
layer_attribution.derivation: Form I (base V) = intransitive inceptive (enter the lifeless state, undergoer-subject); Form IV = causative (put into it, God-agent); masdar/masdar mimi (mawt/mamat), count-noun (mawtah), and substantives (mayyit/mawta/amwat) name the state, its instance, or its bearer. Argument structure comes from morphology, not the root.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: One lexicalized nominal specialization: maytah = carrion, a food-law term of art with prohibition/impurity content beyond the nucleus (16:115:4:2, 2:173:4:2, 5:3:3:2, 6:139:14:1, 6:145:15:1).
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Narrative/contextual overlays - dying wa-hum kuffar (2:161, 9:84), martyrdom (2:154, 3:169), the resurrection-doubt formula a'idha mitna, death personified/created (67:2), malak al-mawt (32:11) - are contextual colouring, NOT part of the root claim; mwt itself is morally neutral.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: No cross-lens conflict required reconciliation on the core; all three lenses agreed the earth-death and pre-life/idol uses are text-bridged (30:50) and that only maytah resists. The one guarded move is refusing to grade on ADJ/N tags, which are non-load-bearing.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The carrion maytah sub-class persists as a lexicalized nominal specialization whose legal-impurity content the nucleus does not generate; this caps the result at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE rather than STRONG/UNIVERSAL, but does not defeat the single-nucleus account.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A mwt occurrence that denotes something other than the lifeless condition or its onset/causation - e.g. a Form I token that is genuinely transitive/causative (a subject making another die), or an occurrence where mwt collapses into qatl (violent slaying) or tawaffa (soul-taking) rather than being contrasted with them - would break the nucleus and the Form I/IV split.
rejection_condition.search_location: Re-examine all 39 Form I tokens for any object-taking use, the qatl co-lists (22:58:9:1, 3:144:11:1, 3:156:21:1, 3:157:7:1, 3:158:2:1, 33:16:8:2) and the tawaffa contexts (39:42:8:1, 4:15:17:2, 6:61:12:2) for any collapse of the distinction.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Check qac_pos/qac_verb_form and argument structure of each candidate against its verse_text; confirm intransitivity of Form I and God-agency of Form IV directly from the packet, and confirm the qatl/tawaffa terms remain lexically separate from mwt in the same verse.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Ignore ADJ vs N QAC tags as semantic evidence (shown non-load-bearing); do not treat contextual/narrative overlays (dying-as-disbeliever, martyrdom) as root meaning; do not import external lexicon glosses - reason only from Quran-internal distribution.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such a finding is verified, downgrade from PREFERRED/MODERATE: either narrow the nucleus, demote the Form I/IV argument-structure claim, or move to UNRESOLVED if the qatl/tawaffa boundary dissolves.

reopen_conditions: Reopen if any Form I (base) token is shown to be transitive/causative (a subject causing another's death), which would collapse the Form I intransitive vs Form IV causative argument-structure split (test against all 39 V tokens incl. 2:243:15:1, 3:119:21:1).

Reopen if the qatl/mwt or tawaffa/mwt distinction is shown to dissolve in any verse (re-examine 22:58:9:1, 3:144:11:1, 33:16:8:2, 39:42:8:1, 6:61:12:2), since the nucleus's distinctiveness rests on those boundaries.

Reopen if the carrion maytah (16:115:4:2, 2:173:4:2, 5:3:3:2, 6:139:14:1, 6:145:15:1) is shown to carry NO legal/impurity content beyond 'lifeless', which would let it rejoin the nucleus and lift the MODERATE cap toward STRONG.

Reopen if any earth-death (ba3da mawtiha) or idol-amwat token is shown to be an unbridged homonym rather than the text-bridged extension at 30:50:10:1/30:50:14:2, which would force a multi-class/UNRESOLVED partition.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The adversary (Lens C) actively sought a defeating occurrence and found none: the single-nucleus (lifeless pole of h-y-y) account is undefeated across all 165 tokens. Full PASSED is withheld because the lexicalized carrion maytah sub-class resists a single narrow gloss (legal-impurity content not generated by the nucleus); per contract this is recorded as NOT_RUN with the resistant occurrences listed rather than claimed as a clean refutation-survival.
